item.title: Grace College Announces The Passing Of Former President Dr. John Davis
item.description: Grace College & Grace Theological Seminary mourns the loss of the institution’s fourth president, Dr. John Davis.

item.title: Young Highlights Importance of Local News During Commerce Hearing
item.description: U.S. Senator Todd Young, a member of the Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation, discussed the importance of local news to American communities during a committee hearing on Tuesday, Feb. 11.

item.title: Stellantis Considering Withdrawal From Samsung-EV Battery Initiative
item.description: Stellantis is weighing a possible withdrawal from its U.S. electric-vehicle battery partnership with South Korea’s Samsung SDI as the automaker scales back EV spending and seeks to preserve cash, according to a report citing people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Columbia City Woman Arrested For Allegedly Stealing Merchandise From Walmart
item.description: A Columbia City woman was arrested in Whitley County for allegedly stealing over $1,000 in merchandise from Walmart.

item.title: South Bend’s Memorial Hospital Ranked Top 50 US Cardiovascular Hospital
item.description: Memorial Hospital of South Bend has earned a spot on the 2026 Modern Healthcare 50 Top Cardiovascular Hospitals list, distinguishing it as the only medical facility in northern Indiana to receive the honor.

item.title: Vital Wellness opens for business
item.description: Vital Wellness had its ribbon-cutting and opened its doors Jan. 19 in Rochester, hosted by the Fulton County Chamber of Commerce.

item.title: Elkhart To Shutter 5 Buildings, Cut Staff In Consolidation Plan
item.description: The Elkhart Community Schools Board of Trustees voted unanimously Tuesday, Feb. 10 to close five elementary schools as the district faces a looming financial crisis driven by plummeting enrollment and aging infrastructure.

item.title: Around 100 Warsaw Students Participate In Anti-ICE Protest
item.description: Around 100 students from Warsaw Community High School participated in a protest against the actions of the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

item.title: Night To Shine Brings Several Guests For Annual Warsaw Event
item.description: Glittery dresses, shiny shoes, and other fancy attire made the night shine as those with special needs danced to their hearts content Friday, Feb. 13.
